user.title: HA Reminder
user.description: Choose whether to configure a person's reminder list or a standalone advanced reminder.

person.title: Person reminders
person.description: These settings control delivery for this person and for any advanced reminder sent to them.

data_description.intervals: Use a comma-separated sequence such as 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h. The last interval repeats.
data_description.quiet_start: Low and normal reminders wait until quiet hours end.
data_description.retry_interval: Wait time after every configured channel fails.
data_description.max_retries: After this many failures, the progressive schedule resumes.

advanced.title: Advanced reminder
advanced.description: Create one reminder device. Each recipient uses their own configured delivery channels and quiet hours.

data_description.recipients: Only people already configured in HA Reminder are available.
data_description.level: Low and normal levels respect quiet hours. High and critical levels do not.
data_description.time_period: Morning, afternoon and evening use fixed times of 09:00, 13:00 and 18:00.
data_description.exact_time: Used only when Time is set to Exact time.
data_description.weekdays: Required when Schedule is Selected weekdays.
data_description.interval_days: Used only when Schedule is Every number of days.
data_description.completion_policy: Choose whether an unfinished occurrence expires overnight or continues until it is completed.
data_description.recurrence_reference: Completion-based recurrence is available only for reminders that continue until completion.

abort.no_configured_people: Configure at least one person before creating an advanced reminder.

person.description: Changes take effect for this person's list and advanced-reminder deliveries.

advanced.description: Editing replaces any active occurrence and calculates the next future one using the new settings.

add_channel.description: The script decides how to send the notification and must return whether it was dispatched.

edit_channel.description: Choose the channel whose name, priority, or enabled state you want to change.

edit_channel_details.description: The selected script remains associated with this channel.

remove_channel.description: Removing a channel never removes pending reminders; they use any remaining channels.

test_channel.description: Runs only the selected script. It does not create or change reminders, schedules, or fallback. {result}

error.test_failed: The script did not confirm delivery. Check its availability and that it returns {"success": true}.

no_delivery_channels.title: No reminder delivery channel is configured
no_delivery_channels.description: Add and enable at least one notification script for this person's reminders.

missing_delivery_script.title: A reminder delivery script is missing
missing_delivery_script.description: Update or remove the channel that refers to a script no longer available in Home Assistant.
